country.analysis_ne: हाल नेपालको पश्चिमी क्षेत्रमा पश्चिमी वायूको तथा पुर्वी क्षेत्रमा भारतको ओडीसा आसपास अवस्थित न्युन चापीय क्षेत्रको आंशिक प्रभाव रहेको छ ।
country.analysis_en: The western part of Nepal is currently under the influence of westerly winds, while the eastern part is under the partial influence of a well marked low-pressure system located around Odisha, India.
country.day_ne: लुम्बिनी, कर्णाली र सुदूरपश्चिम प्रदेशका सबै क्षेत्रमा साथै देशको हिमाली क्षेत्रमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ। कोशी प्रदेशको तराई क्षेत्रमा तथा मधेश प्रदेशमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ। बाँकी क्षेत्रमा मौसम मूख्यतया सफा रहनेछ। कोशी प्रदेशको तराई भू-भागका एक-दुई स्थानमा मेघगर्जन/चट्याङ्ग सहित हल्का वर्षाको सम्भावना छ।
country.day_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail throughout Lumbini, Karnali and Sudurpashchim Provinces, as well as in the Himalayan regions of the country. Partly cloudy conditions will also prevail in the Terai region of Koshi Province and in Madhesh Province, while the weather will remain mainly fair in the remaining areas. Light rainfall with thunder and lightning is likely at one or two places in the Terai region of Koshi Province.
country.night_ne: देशको हिमाली क्षेत्रमा साथै मधेश प्रदेश र कोशी प्रदेशको तराई क्षेत्रमा आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ । कोशी प्रदेशको तराई भू-भागका साथै मधेश प्रदेशको एक-दुई स्थानमा मेघगर्जन/चट्याङ्ग सहित हल्का वर्षाको सम्भावना छ। तराई भू-भाग, उपत्यका तथा खोँचहरूमा बिहानपख थोरै स्थानमा हुस्सु/कुहिरो लाग्नेछ।
country.night_en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail in the Himalayan regions of the country, as well as in Madhesh Province and the Terai region of Koshi Province. Mist/fog is likely at a few places in the Terai regions, valleys and gorge during the early morning. Light rainfall with thunder and lightning is likely at one or two places in the Terai region of Koshi Province and Madhesh Province.
